results.sql: WITH "net_revenue" AS (SELECT SUM("l"."price_lcl" * "fx"."rate") AS "net_revenue_brl" FROM (SELECT "ord_id", "cust_id", "ord_stat_cd", "purch_ts", "appr_ts", "carrier_ts", "dlvr_ts", "est_dlvr_dt", "is_deleted", "src_sys_cd" FROM "sales"."ord_hdr" WHERE (is_deleted = FALSE)) AS "h" JOIN (SELECT "ord_id", "line_no", "prod_id", "seller_id", "ship_lmt_ts", "price_lcl", "frt_lcl", "ccy_cd" FROM "sales"."ord_line") AS "l" ON "l"."ord_id" = "h"."ord_id" JOIN (SELECT "rate_dt", "from_ccy", "to_ccy", "rate", "is_filled" FROM "finance"."fx_rate_daily") AS "fx" ON "fx"."rate_dt" = CAST("h"."purch_ts" AS DATE) WHERE NOT "h"."ord_stat_cd" IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND "h"."purch_ts" >= CAST('2017-04-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND "h"."purch_ts" < CAST('2018-04-01' AS TIMESTAMP)) SELECT "net_revenue"."net_revenue_brl" * (SELECT "fx_rate_daily"."rate" AS "rate" FROM (SELECT "rate_dt", "from_ccy", "to_ccy", "rate", "is_filled" FROM "finance"."fx_rate_daily") AS "fx_rate_daily" WHERE "fx_rate_daily"."rate_dt" = CAST('2018-03-31' AS DATE)) AS "net_revenue_usd" FROM "net_revenue" AS "net_revenue" ORDER BY "net_revenue_usd" DESC LIMIT 1000
assumptions: The question asks for total net revenue in the fiscal year 2018, which starts on April 1, 2018.
Amounts converted from BRL to USD at the daily rate of the order date.
